blocks.text: Bunyadi zarre yeh mane jate hain: chhe quarks, chhe leptons aur gauge bosons, jo fundamental forces ko 'utha kar le jate' (carry karte) hain. Leptons aur quarks bosons bhej aur le kar ek doosre par asar karte hain. Maslan electromagnetic asar tab hota hai jab do charged zarre photons ka len-den (exchange) karte hain; kehte hain ke photons charged zarron ke darmiyan force 'carry' karte hain. Isi tarah nucleus mein do quarks ke darmiyan kashish gluons ke len-den se hoti hai. W⁺, W⁻ aur Z bosons weak nuclear force ke carriers hain, aur gravitons (jo abhi tak dekhe nahi gaye) gravity ke. Higgs boson ek khaas zarra hai jo 2012 mein CERN ke Large Hadron Collider mein daryaft hua. Yeh Higgs field se jura hai jo poori space mein phaili hui hai. Is ka aham kirdar yeh batana hai ke doosre zarre is field se asar kar ke mass kaise pate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab gauge bosons ke saath bracket mein '(Higgs bosons)' likhti hai, jaise Higgs boson bhi force le jata ho. Aisa nahi: force le jane wale gauge bosons photon, gluons aur W⁺, W⁻, Z hain. Higgs boson alag bunyadi boson hai jo zarron ke mass se talluq rakhta hai.

Jo zarre Higgs field se zyada asar karte hain woh zyada mass pate hain, jaise electroweak force ke carriers W⁺, W⁻ aur Z bosons; jabke photons jaise zarre Higgs field se asar nahi karte, is liye un ka rest mass zero mana jata hai. Higgs boson ka mass taqreeban 125 giga-electron-volts (GeV) hai aur yeh foran doosre zarron mein toot jata hai. Kuch aham baatein:

items: Higgs boson apna mass apni Higgs field se asar ki wajah se pata hai.
Apni anokhi khususiyat ki wajah se yeh Big Bang (kitab mein 'Bing Bang') ke foran baad ki kaainat ki halat aur dark matter ki nishaniyan dhoondhne ka anokha darwaza (portal) ho sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Jadeed physics ke nazariyat mein mass paida karne mein Higgs boson ka kirdar bataiye (short question 12.14). Bunyadi zarron ke mass ka zimmedar kaunsa zarra hai (MCQ 12.17)?
blocks.explanation: Space Higgs field se bhari hai; zarre is se taamul kar ke mass pate hain, zyada taamul karne wale jaise W aur Z bosons zyada mass pate hain, jabke photons, jo taamul nahi karte, be-mass rehte hain. Higgs boson is field ka zarra hai; 2012 mein CERN par taqreeban 125 GeV par is ki daryaft ne field ke wujood ki tasdeeq ki. MCQ 12.17 ka jawab (d), Higgs boson.

items: Bunyadi zarre: 6 quarks, 6 leptons aur bosons. Force carriers: photons (electromagnetic), gluons (strong), W⁺, W⁻, Z (weak), gravitons (gravity, tajweez shuda). Higgs boson force carrier nahi.
Higgs boson: CERN ke Large Hadron Collider mein 2012, taqreeban 125 GeV; Higgs field zarron ko mass deti hai (W aur Z zyada, photons zero); foran decay; ibtidai kaainat aur dark matter ka darwaza.
